possible_explanations.statement: Interconnector transfer limits or an outage might have reduced the ability to import to SA (see the Tailem_Bnd inter-regional transfer limit notice [c2]); the net interchange at the peak interval was -82.59 MW.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Review the inter-regional transfer limit notice [c2] (it reports a rescheduled outage from 1830 hrs 28/07/2026 UTC 2026-07-28T08:30:00Z to 1200 hrs 01/08/2026 UTC 2026-08-01T02:00:00Z) and check interconnector transfer limit and constraint binding reports for intervals around 2026-07-30T16:35:00Z (2026-07-30T16:35:00Z is the peak interval UTC returned by the price timeline).

possible_explanations.statement: Local generation reductions or unit unavailability might have coincided with the high prices; generation-change observations show decreases at PPCCGT (change -76.51 MW) and AGLHAL (change -72.11 MW) alongside an increase at SNAPPER (change 99.46 MW).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Examine unit availability, outage records and bidding/rebid histories for units with changes reported in the tool window 2026-07-30T12:00:00Z–2026-07-30T18:00:00Z and compare offer volumes to actual dispatch.

possible_explanations.statement: A system non-credible contingency reported by AEMO might be relevant (the notice reports a 'Non-credible contingency event - SA region - 30/07/2026' [c1]).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare the non-credible contingency notice [c1] clock times (UTC 2026-07-30T01:40:00Z; local 2026-07-30 11:10 ACST (UTC+0930)) with dispatch and constraint actions following that notice to see whether any manifestly incorrect input (MII) review, constraint change or other operational action was recorded in subsequent intervals.

possible_explanations.statement: A rapid rise in dispatch TOTALDEMAND over the half hour into 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z (seen in five-minute TOTALDEMAND values) might be related to the price spike.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare pre-dispatch forecasts, pre-dispatch demand rebids and dispatchable unit bids for the intervals up to and including interval ending 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z; check whether forecast/offer changes align with the observed five-minute TOTALDEMAND sequence.

possible_explanations.statement: Changes in local generation output (SCADA changes observed in the 00:00–06:00 UTC window, e.g. large TVCCPS change) could be associated with the observed price interval.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Inspect unit-level rebid logs, outage reports and dispatch MW schedules for units with SCADA changes around 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z to see if bidding or availability changes occurred in the intervals immediately before 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z.

possible_explanations.statement: The net export at the peak interval (63.84 MW) might be relevant to supply/demand balance at the time of the price spike.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Examine interconnector constraint/limit records, dispatch constraint notices and any interconnector capability changes for intervals up to 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z to determine if interconnector conditions changed near that interval.

question: In AEMO's paper on demand terms, what is 'Total Demand', the figure the dispatch process starts from? Where is it measured, and does it net out scheduled load consumption and interconnector losses?

answer_as_displayed.headline: Total Demand is calculated by the NEM Dispatch Engine (NEMDE) and is used as the launch point for the central dispatch process which performs the regional price calculations in Dispatch, Pre-dispatch and five-minute pre-dispatch, and determines dispatch targets for generating units. [c1]
summary: “Total Demand is the forecast demand at the Regional Reference Node (RRN) that is met by local generation from scheduled and semi-scheduled generating units and scheduled BDUs plus interconnector imports, excluding the local demand of scheduled loads and scheduled BDUs and the allocated interconnector losses, but including the demand met by Wholesale Demand Response.” [c1]

Total Demand is calculated by the NEM Dispatch Engine (NEMDE) and is used as the launch point for the central dispatch process which performs the regional price calculations in Dispatch, Pre-dispatch and five-minute pre-dispatch, and determines dispatch targets for generating units. [c1]

“Allocated Interconnector Losses = Sum (MWLosses x FromRegionLossShare A) Over all Interconnectors connected to the region” [c4]

In Dispatch and the first interval of five-minute pre-dispatch, Total Demand is computed from SCADA actuals by summing scheduled and semi-scheduled generation plus net actual interconnector flow, minus actual demand of regional scheduled loads and estimated actual allocated interconnector losses, plus Wholesale Demand Response, DemandForecast and AggregateDispatchError. possible_explanations.statement: AEMO's non-conformance notice for TRGBESS1 (market_notice_144635) might be relevant to available capability or constraint equations noted in that notice [market_notice_144635].
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Check TRGBESS1 conformance records and the unit's dispatch and offers for 27–28 July (compare the non-conformance notice text and unit dispatch history) to see any linkage to constraint sets or capability the next day.

published_findings.statement: An AEMO market notice for VIC1 [c1] says: “AEMO has declared the following unit as non-conforming under clause 3.8.23 of the National Electricity Rules: Unit: TRGBESS1”
An AEMO market notice for VIC1 [c2] says: “At 1729 hrs the Moorabool No. 2 220 kV Bus tripped.” (Notice times are NEM market time, UTC+10.)
An AEMO market notice for VIC1 [c3] says: “AEMO has invoked automated constraint set CA_SYDS_597A8B26 from 11:00 hrs until further notice.” (Notice times are NEM market time, UTC+10.)
An AEMO market notice for VIC1 [c4] says: “AEMO has invoked automated constraint set CA_SYDS_597B3DBD from 23:40 hrs until further notice.” (Notice times are NEM market time, UTC+10.)
An AEMO market notice for VIC1 [c5] says: “AEMO has invoked automated constraint set CA_SYDS_597B5710 from 0130 hrs until further notice.” (Notice times are NEM market time, UTC+10.)

An AEMO market notice for VIC1 [c6] says: “At 0810 hrs 27/07/2026 there was a short notice outage of Alcoa Portland 2 220 kV Bus.” (NEM market time, UTC+10: 2026-07-26T22:10:00Z = 2026-07-27 08:10 AEST.)

uncertainties: Generator bids/offers and rebid history for the intervals around 2026-07-28T11:20:00Z are not available here; the marginal clearing offer cannot be confirmed.
Constraint binding flags for CA_SYDS_597A8B26 and other invoked sets are not available in the retrieved evidence; binding status is unknown.
Settlement residue accumulation details are not available; cannot assess whether residue mitigation policy was relevant.
missing_evidence: Per-interval generator and battery bid/offer stacks and rebid messages for 2026-07-28 around 11:20 UTC.
